candidate_bootstrap: Same matched-question draws across representations, models, protocols and pairs; difference-of-deltas is paired, not subtraction of interval endpoints. Pointwise intervals, no multiplicity correction.
full_task_analysis: Regenerated by this command (--full-out) with the same seed and iterations; its estimands are unchanged.

matching.rule: Exact question text; answer keys strip surrounding whitespace and terminal periods only; unique candidates with agreeing truth labels required. Scored strings and loglikelihoods are unchanged.

metric_definitions.brier: Categorical sum over offered choices, including two-choice tasks: twice the legacy binary Brier (1 - p_correct)^2.
metric_definitions.ece: 10 equal-frequency bins; stable sample-order ties, rebuilt in every bootstrap draw.
metric_definitions.nll: Unclipped logsumexp minus target loglikelihood; nats. The legacy binary NLL clips p_correct at 1e-12.
metric_definitions.risk_coverage: Most-confident-first error rate, with expected risk for random ordering within exact confidence ties. AURC averages the risk of every prefix k = 1..n; random_ranking_risk is the same model's error rate, the AURC of a random ordering. Curves and AURC are descriptive, without intervals.

tasks.binary: 790-question A/B-label derivative: normalized ' A'/' B' likelihoods.
tasks.matched_mc1_all_candidates: Matched questions, standard MC1 over all of its candidates.
tasks.matched_strings: Matched questions, standard-prompt likelihoods of the same two answer strings, renormalized over those two.
tasks.mc1: 817-question standard MC1: all candidate answer strings.

temperature_scaling.bootstrap: Paired test-question percentile intervals, conditional on fixed split and fitted temperatures/priors. No refitting; no training-seed, fitting or numerical uncertainty.
temperature_scaling.constant: Calibration-only add-one-smoothed position prior stratified by candidate count; unseen counts use uniform. MC1 positions are hash-permuted first to prevent a truth-first index-zero oracle. Binary and matched tasks keep A/B coordinates.
temperature_scaling.mc2: Held-out truth mass after transferring the MC1-fitted temperature and MC1 constant position priors (uniform for unseen counts) to MC2. MC2 has multiple true answers: no one-hot MC2 target, ECE or calibration-repair claim is defined.
temperature_scaling.objective: Calibration-only categorical NLL; convex inverse-temperature bisection.
temperature_scaling.split: SHA256(seed|exact question text), first eight bytes / 2^64 < 0.5; shared across models, protocols and tasks.
temperature_scaling.uniform: Equal probability over offered candidates; deterministic argmax. MC1 baselines use the same blinded coordinates as constant.
